decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a  rear roof extensions and side roof extension to the dwelling house at 147 Jersey Road would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding Conservation Area, and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003), and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extension  is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof extension  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 147 Jersey Road.

Condition : 6 - Informative
This permission relates only to the erection of a two-storey rear roof and side roof  extension,  to the existing house.  It does not include the erection of a single storey rear extension as shown on plan O1A, which would have to be the subject of a further Planning Application.
description: Erection of 2 rear roof and side roof extension to existing house.
